messages:
alice: Quick heads up — saw a perf regression on prod for long sequences. Telemetry shows unexpected kernel picks on Ampere hosts (A100). seqlen=1536 batch=1 latency +18% vs canary.

ben: Can you paste the raw telemetry lines for one of the slow requests?

alice: Here’s a sanitized snippet from channel=inference.pick.rationale:
```
deploy: prod/cluster-7
host_arch: ampere
seq_len: 1536
batch_size: 1
kernel_chosen: matmul_generic_v1
profile_score: 0.12
reason_flags: fallback_no_specialized, seqlen_bucket=long, kv_cache_estimated=false
trace_id: t-2156784321-7
```

ben: That looks like a fallback pick (matmul_generic_v1). Two quick checks: 1) was the specialized kernel library loaded on that node? 2) did the autotuner compute a negative delta because KV cache behavior wasn't modeled? Try RUNTIME_KPICK_DEBUG=1 to get pick-time diagnostics.

caroline: Also verify RK_AUTOTUNE_SEQ_THRESH and RK_ARCH_PROFILE envs. If the seq bucket thresholds were updated, some long sequences can still end up in "generic" bucket.

alice: Reproduced locally by setting RK_ARCH_PROFILE=ampere and forcing seq bucket=long. When I set RK_FORCE_KERNEL=matmul_fused_v2 latency returns to baseline. So autotune picked wrong candidate.

ben: Hmm. Noted. My hunch: autotuner scoring omitted kv hit contribution — if KV cache hit probability is high the fused kernel can be worse (cold vs warm paths). For long seqs we should include kv_hit_rate_estimate in the pick score.

caroline: I’ll add a telemetry field pick_context.kv_hit_estimate and a debug flag RK_PICK_LOG_KV=true so picks log the KV stat used. That will let us retro-run scorer on existing traces.

dev-bot: sample saved: s3://redwood-telemetry/picks/2156784321/t-2156784321-7.json :eyes: 

alice: Filed perf issue: INF-RUNTIME-4567 with repro, trace id, and local experiment results. Assigning to @ben and @caroline. :thumbsup: 

ben: Plan: (1) add kv_hit_estimate to pick telemetry (caroline), (2) re-run autotune accounting for KV, (3) add guardrail: if pick_score delta < 0.05 prefer specialized kernel for long seqs on Ampere. Will also expose RUNTIME_KPICK_DEBUG and RK_PICK_OVERRIDE via config. ETA EOD tomorrow for step (1).

caroline: PR draft incoming — will include unit test for seqlen bucket boundaries and a small perf harness to simulate kv hit rates.

alice: Thanks. One more ask: include which kernel artifact version was loaded in telemetry (lib_version). We had a node with old lib yesterday.

ben: Good call. Add lib_version and kernel_symbol_hash to telemetry.

dev-bot: trace pinned to ticket INF-RUNTIME-4567. Arch tag: ampere, severity: medium.

alice: :eyes: will monitor canary after change. Thanks team.
